attributes.board_name: Nevada State Board of Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Qualifying subject matter and activities per NAC 640A.090 (some capped, e.g. attending Board or professional-organization meetings); other CE only with written Board approval requested by the renewal date. Fieldwork supervision credit, a given course, and the jurisprudence exam count only once per cycle. 1 hour = 60 minutes excluding meals and breaks.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed within 12 months of graduating from an accredited program: 12 hours for the first renewal.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 hours above 24 may be carried to the next biennial cycle.
rules.audit_note: Submit a list of completed courses and activities with the renewal application; the Board conducts random audits.

topics.who: Pass the Nevada Occupational Therapy Jurisprudence Examination at least once every 5 years

rules.notes: Standard licenses expire 2 years after the date issued.
rules.rule_quote: …a person with a standard license shall complete, to the satisfaction of the Board, at least 24 hours of continuing education per biennial renewal cycle.
